description: Reportes de Eventos Sísmicos, 2019-2026. is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Servicio Geológico Nacional SGN. Este conjunto de datos contiene los Reportes de Eventos Sísmicos recopilados por el Servicio Geológico Nacional (SGN) del 2019-2026, en el cual puede encontrar los sismos registrados, sus coordenadas y otras informaciones relevantes. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Servicio Geológico Nacional SGN. Its tags are Minería, geología, medio ambiente. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
